shell.quit.stops.defaultMessage: {how, select, workspace {{busy, select, yes {{n, plural, one {Closing the workspace stops its session.} other {Closing the workspace stops its # sessions.}}} other {{n, plural, one {Closing the workspace stops its running session.} other {Closing the workspace stops its # running sessions.}}}}} switch {{busy, select, yes {{n, plural, one {Switching workspace stops this workspace's session.} other {Switching workspace stops this workspace's # sessions.}}} other {{n, plural, one {Switching workspace stops this workspace's running session.} other {Switching workspace stops this workspace's # running sessions.}}}}} window {{busy, select, yes {{n, plural, one {Closing this window stops this workspace's session.} other {Closing this window stops this workspace's # sessions.}}} other {{n, plural, one {Closing this window stops this workspace's running session.} other {Closing this window stops this workspace's # running sessions.}}}}} allWindows {{windows, plural, other {{busy, select, yes {{n, plural, one {Quitting closes all {windows, number} windows and stops its session.} other {Quitting closes all {windows, number} windows and stops all # sessions, in every workspace.}}} other {{n, plural, one {Quitting closes all {windows, number} windows and stops the running session.} other {Quitting closes all {windows, number} windows and stops # running sessions, in every workspace.}}}}}}} other {{busy, select, yes {{n, plural, one {Quitting stops its session.} other {Quitting stops all # sessions.}}} other {{n, plural, one {Quitting stops the running session.} other {Quitting stops # running sessions.}}}}}}

shell.quit.unsaved.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# file has unsaved changes.} other {# files have unsaved changes.}}
shell.quit.unsaved.description: The quit dialog: how many open files have unsaved edits (listed under it).

shell.quit.when.defaultMessage: {action, select, saveAndClose {Save and close} closeWorkspace {Close workspace} switchWorkspace {Switch workspace} closeWindow {Close window} saveAndQuit {Save and quit} other {Quit}} when {working, plural, one {the agent finishes} other {agents finish}}
shell.quit.when.description: The quit dialog's button: quit once the working agents finish. {action} picks what it does (quit, or save and quit); {working} is how many agents are working.
